sourceRefs.locator: Gregory IX.42; Epistolae 914, first paragraphs and final appeal: Chlothar’s resources, Agnes’s election, obedience of the founder, protection of property, and burial in the church dedicated to Mary even if unfinished.
Section on the nuns of Poitiers, pp. 136–142; narrative setting of the 589 appeal, inserted letters in IX.39–42 and the episcopal tribunal of 590 in X.16.

labels.de: Radegundes Brief zum Schutz des Klosters
labels.en: Radegund’s letter for the protection of her convent

summary.de: Gregor überliefert Radegundes Appell an die Bischöfe, Agnes und die Ausstattung der Gemeinschaft nach ihrem Tod zu schützen.
summary.en: Gregory preserves Radegund’s appeal to bishops to protect Agnes and the community’s endowment after her death.
